{"path": "servo.py", "content": "from gpiozero import Servo
from time import sleep
# Software PWM under a non-realtime kernel jitters, and the old GPIO library is broken on Pi 5.
# gpiozero Servo uses hardware-timed PWM via lgpio.
servo = Servo(17)
while True:
    servo.min()
    sleep(1)
    servo.mid()
    sleep(1)
    servo.max()
    sleep(1)
"}

text: Fixed: software PWM jitters on a non-realtime kernel and the old GPIO library is broken on Pi 5. Rewrote the script with gpiozero Servo, which uses hardware-timed PWM via lgpio on Pi 5.
